About

Advertising, studied
before it is made.

I research competitor ads through the Google Ads Transparency Center and Meta Ads Library — reading creatives, messaging, offers and promotional angles — then turn those insights into campaigns I can launch.

Alongside strategy I build with AI: UGC-style concepts, promotional videos and social-first creatives using OpenAI, Claude, Kimi, Seedance and Canva. Curious about business, branding and where AI is taking digital media.
